messages:
Ava (Docs): started a tiny PR to add a 'provisioning cheatcode' section for Dedicated reserved pools: quick YAML, CLI, and Python SDK snippets. can folks sanity-check eviction/isolation wording and link targets? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1625 :wave:
Ben (Runtime): quick tech check: use 'eviction' not 'preemption'. keys: eviction_policy (graceful|immediate|delayed), eviction_priority (low|medium|high). delayed triggers a cooldown (default 300s). we've also got isolation_level (tenant|node|gpu).
Ava (Docs): current YAML in PR:
```yaml
name: gpu-cheat
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 10
eviction_policy: graceful
eviction_priority: low
isolation_level: node
```
Claire (CLI): note flags are kebab-case in the CLI: --eviction-priority and --isolation-level. Also change examples to match exact flag names or tests fail.
Diego (Product): SLA line: keep it short. Suggest: "Reserved capacity: guaranteed baseline per contract. Burst: best-effort, subject to pool and regional availability." link to SLA page.
Ava (Docs): will adopt Diego's phrasing and add a one-line billing note: "Burst billed at on-demand rates; reserved billed under commitment."
redwood-docs-bot: CI link check failed: docs/quickstarts/dedicated.md -> /handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools.md 404. Suggested /handbook/dedicated/reserved-pools-guide.md
Ava (Docs): ack, updating links.
Ben (Runtime): add callout near the flowchart: "Fallback to hosted occurs only after sustained SLO violation per routing policy; Private customers can opt out."
Claire (CLI): can we add a tiny Python SDK snippet for parity? e.g.:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.dedicated.create_pool(name="gpu-cheat", min_instances=2, max_instances=10, eviction_policy="graceful")
```
Ava (Docs): adding Python and a short TS example. Also adding alt text for flowchart and an accessibility text-summary.
Diego (Product): one extra ask: add a tiny note about isolation_level=gpu (pins a full GPU to a tenant; higher cost).
Ben (Runtime): LGTM for technical bits. I'll post one inline comment on the PR about eviction_priority casing (lowercase).
Claire (CLI): ping me after you push and I'll run the CLI smoke test on the example flags.
Ava (Docs): thanks all 44d I'll push updates (flags, YAML tweak, SLA + billing lines, SDK snippets, flowchart callout, alt text, link fixes). Please drop a quick review so I can merge today.
